correctness.rationale: For each k>=2, N=2^k, decompose the fixed Thue–Morse word into µ^k blocks P and complement Pbar. Each length-N factor is a rotation of P or a mixed cut-and-join of adjacent unlike blocks. These supply N+2(N-1)=3N-2 distinct factors because the classical factor-complexity theorem gives that exact total and the same-block rotations are distinct. Circular pair counts H_k=(N+2(-1)^k)/6 follow from substitution recurrence; mixed cuts are classified by odd/even offset, endpoint bits, and a telescoping prefix 00-minus-11 count. Summing six mixed cases plus rotations yields eight signatures: even k six classes of (N-1)/3 and two N/2; odd k four of (N-2)/6, two N/2 and two (2N-1)/3. Independent literal-factor enumeration verified exact class sizes and total 3N-2 for k=2..9. Infinite statement rests on block-count and recurrence proof, not samples.
